Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this game. New Zealand are underway in the triangular series. The action continues as New Zealand will face Pakistan on 11th October. The match will start at 7.30 am IST (2 am GMT). Do join us early for the coverage. Till then, cheers!

Kane Williamson, the captain of New Zealand says Bangladesh played nicely in the Powerplay but they pulled it well back with the spin. Adds there are many things to take into account while bowling the spinners but all three bowled well. On Ish Sodhi, he is amazing and aggressive and has won a lot of matches, hope there are plenty more to come. Shares that it was unusual to see caches going down but hopes to get better. On Adam Milne going off the field, Kane replies that there are few niggles going on, the schedule is tight going into the World Cup but they need to be smart with the players.

Shakib Al Hasan, the skipper of Bangladesh says the Kiwis bowled really well. Adds they never got the momentum, the batters tried to go for big shots but holed out. Shares that it is not happening for them but they will keep improving. Tells there were spinners bowling in the middle phase so that is why he came down the order. Reckons the bowlers have been good and the fielders have been backing really well. Says the next two games will be crucial and hopes to build some momentum

Michael Bracewell is the Player of the Match. He says their bowlers have the experience and it is challenging sometimes in the nets but exciting as well. Adds they have a good group of spinners and he is picking brains from all of them. Applauds Ish Sodhi's performance. Reckons he tries to contribute with the bat as well, he will do whatever the team asks for.
...Presentation coming up...

Earlier, New Zealand did well after choosing to bowl first. They kept Bangladesh under control throughout the innings. All the bowlers had a great day. In reply, it was a convincing performance with the bat by New Zealand.

Bangladesh were good in the first 6 overs or so but in the middle overs, their spinners weren't as effective as they would have wanted them to be. However, the bowlers just did not have enough to play with. On this wicket, 137 is really difficult to defend.

A comfortable win for the Kiwis. 138 was always under par and the Kiwis have chased it down quite easily. They went about it quite sensibly. Devon Conway was the mainstay and the rest batted around him. They needed one good partnership and it came, it was between Kane Williamson and Conway and that partnership more or less sealed the deal for them.

SIX! Clubbed! This is full and on middle. Phillips thumps it over long on for a biggie. New Zealand win by 8 wickets. Glenn Phillips hits the winning runs and rushes straight to the spectator who got hit in the crowd. A nice gesture from Phillips.
A halt as the ball went onto hit one of the spectator in the crowd.
SIX! New Zealand inching closer! Short in length and on middle. Phillips stays back and pulls it flat and over square leg for a biggie.
Another single as this is hit to mid on.
On middle, pushed to mid on for a single.
FOUR! Short and onn middle. Phillips looks to pull, it goes more off the gloves to fine leg for four runs.
Outside off. Phillips miscues his pull to point. A single. 14 runs needed more.
On middle, nudged to mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Phillips looks to punch but gets an inside edge and it rolls off the pads on the leg side for one.
Three runs! Pitched up, outside off. Conway drives it to deep cover. The fielder across had to cover a lot of ground. Three runs taken.
On off, blocked out.
FOUR! Glorious! This is full and around off. Conway drives it straight past the bowler for a boundary.
On middle, pushed to the right of Shakib who dives and makes a good stop.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
FOUR! Phillips is off the mark in style! Tossed up on middle, slower and Phillips smashes it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Follows Conway on the leg side with a full ball, it is hit to long on.
Tossed up, on middle, a slider. Conway misses his sweep. An appeal for LBW but it was pitching outside leg.
On middle, worked to square leg.
Glenn Phillips is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! The 85-run stand is broken! On a length and on middle.  Williamson tries a straight drive but it goes off the inner half of the bat and Taskin Ahmed at mid on takes a simple catch. A little too late by Bangladesh. 29 runs needed in 30 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Taskin Ahmed b Hasan Mahmud

OUT! TAKEN! There is the wicket Bangladesh wanted! They have been excellent after an expensive first over! On the pads, this is whipped but straight to deep square leg. It is taken by Najmul Hossain Shanto!
